mapper.sql: id, support_program_id, model, prompt_version, status, eligibility_json::text AS eligibility_json, exclusion_json::text AS exclusion_json, required_documents_json::text AS required_documents_json, support_amount_json::text AS support_amount_json, uncertain_conditions_json::text AS uncertain_conditions_json, evidence_json::text AS evidence_json, preference_json::text AS preference_json, summary, error_code, error_message, analyzed_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO ai_analysis (support_program_id, model, prompt_version, status) VALUES (#{supportProgramId}, #{model}, #{promptVersion}, 'ANALYZING') ON CONFLICT (support_program_id, prompt_version) DO UPDATE SET model = EXCLUDED.model, status = 'ANALYZING', eligibility_json = NULL, exclusion_json = NULL, required_documents_json = NULL, support_amount_json = NULL, uncertain_conditions_json = NULL, evidence_json = NULL, preference_json = NULL, summary = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, analyzed_at = NULL RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_analysis SET model = #{model}, status = 'COMPLETED', eligibility_json = #{eligibilityJson}::jsonb, exclusion_json = #{exclusionJson}::jsonb, required_documents_json = #{requiredDocumentsJson}::jsonb, support_amount_json = #{supportAmountJson}::jsonb, uncertain_conditions_json = #{uncertainConditionsJson}::jsonb, evidence_json = #{evidenceJson}::jsonb, preference_json = #{preferenceJson}::jsonb, summary = #{summary}, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, analyzed_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
